H74 (also priority 1) was passed over deliberately as compute re-allocation inside the current design, which is what divergent mode forbids. THE KILL IS INFORMATIVE BECAUSE THE OPERATOR IS CORRECT AND THE DECOMPOSITION IS REAL. Census over every stored order on all three datasets: 264 pairs (78 connectome from 13 distinct orders out of 58 files, 120 microns, 66 mouse). k reaches 10,553 on connectome / 4,428 microns / 118 mouse; the decomposition reproduces the frozen scorer on 264/264; the cross-block orientation premise holds on 264/264; predicted == realised on 41/41 rebuilt offspring. AND THE BEST-OF-2^k GAIN OVER max(parents) IS EXACTLY 0.00000000 pp ON ALL 264 PAIRS. The reason is structural: k counts SINGLETONS, which carry no internal edge and are ties by construction. Only 1-11 blocks per pair have size > 1, and ONE GIANT BLOCK holds 92.28-100.00% of the nodes and 98.18-100.00% of the edge mass, so n_nontrivial_choices is 1 or 2 and 2^k collapses to the 2 parents - the best-of-R that M9 priced and M16 already measured at 0.000000 pp. AGAINST THE CHAMPION H64 THERE IS NO PROPER CUT AT ALL: k = 1 against every other stored order and against the reference solution. The pipeline agrees on the low-degree periphery and disagrees about the whole core: median degree 3.0 in singleton blocks vs 59.0 in the giant block, ~20x. NEW META-RULE M19-no-shared-interior-structure: the campaign's solutions share no interior structure to recombine, so every exact recombination operator on them degenerates to selection over the parents - this closes the multi-start family on a FOURTH independent axis (after H56 relabelling, H57 prefix sharing, H79/M16 basin) and closes it CONSTRUCTIVELY rather than statistically. Run experiments/proto_h82_px_census.py before building ANY population / crossover / tour-merging / path-relinking mechanism; it is O(n+m) per pair and a free kill. DIAGNOSTIC ARM (measurement only, via mfas.analysis.gap): champion x reference gives k = 1, so 0.000000 pp of M15's 0.356498 pp residual is block-decomposable - the FOURTH geometric family of partial adoption to return exactly zero, and the strongest, because PX is monotone-safe by construction and exact. H83 died on the same evidence: its pre-gate passes over the whole line (188-13,603 positions with D(p) <= 32) but only on END EFFECTS (median such position 0.0006*n from an end); in the deep interior there are ZERO on all 7 pairs, and one forced interior cut costs >= 706 node relocations, back inside M15's 0.786097 pp valley. A BUG WORTH REMEMBERING: the first kernel cast weights to int64 unconditionally, silently truncating every MOUSE weight to 0 (mouse weights are floats, total 9.0); only the mouse smoke test caught it. Match the frozen scorer's accumulator choice. P23 checked FIRST for the tenth cycle running, still awaiting-operator. gates_run lists two rungs and only two - the prototype settled it.

_escalation_note: cycles_since_score_move is the PRIMARY divergence trigger as of 2026-08-15 (campaign.yaml escalation.divergent_after_k_cycles_without_score_move: 3). Increment it at the end of EVERY cycle regardless of verdict; reset to 0 only on a champion change. It replaces consecutive_kills as the primary trigger because that counter never left 0 in 7 cycles - 4 of them were infrastructure items, which by construction never increment it, and both science items passed. At 3 the campaign is FORCED out of incremental mode and an infrastructure item no longer satisfies the requirement.
